tower.fit: Original connected blocked footprint; inferred depth within its boundary.
tower.profile_source: Original alpha silhouette above the lower roots; original blue surface spans below. Native width/axis fit within two pixels; garden footprint unchanged. Hidden depth remains inferred.
tower.material_source: Original RGB retained on structural/garden masks and four recovered gold root components. Occluded garden surfaces extend adjacent original paint; no new scenery or source colors.

shell.source: Curved original front surface; mirrored hidden depth is inferred. Every visible front UV projects to its original pixel.

tower.terrace_fit: Smooth ellipse inside the original blocked footprint; original source apron retained. Hidden circular depth is inferred.
tower.root_height_source: One physical tip height inferred from the four original projected tips. Front/rear depth slopes differ; original front colors and projected silhouettes remain source-derived.

body_fill.source: Only shaft pixels hidden by the four original support silhouettes receive adjacent original blue paint. Visible native RGB and the original tower master are unchanged.

fence.source: Original lower-front gold filigree, repeated around both original garden terraces. Occluded rear repeats are inferred.

limits: The archive contains rendered art, not original meshes. Tower rear surfaces and depth are inferred from its visible circular profiles.

shore.source: Original navy sea pixels only; original walkable island ground and its rim stay at zero. Unreachable exterior water is not island ground.
